name: Puzzle Date
source: Puzzle Date is a side project of Tlaero written while Mortze was working on SWM. It is quite different than their other games. Although it has multiple sex scenes and some semblance of a story, including a Male path and a Lesbian one, it's really a Match3 game where the Match3 parts are a metaphor for what is going on in the date. Go in with eyes open.​
translation: Puzzle Date是Tlaero在Mortze从事SWM工作时编写的一个业余项目。这与他们的其他游戏有很大不同。虽然它有多个性爱场景和一些类似的故事，包括男性路径和女同性恋路径，但这实际上是一款三消游戏，其中三消部分隐喻了约会中发生的事情。睁着眼睛进去。​
